errors.evidence: The description of the horizontal axis unit is incomplete. It states it is labeled in "thousands of leva", but the full label on the chart is "хил.лв./заето лице" (thousands of BGN per person employed). The omission of "per person employed" is significant as it is a crucial part of the productivity measure.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за „Преработваща промишленост“ са оцветени в червено
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for "Преработваща промишленост" (Manufacturing industry) is colored red. According to the chart, the red bar corresponds to "ДОБИВНА ПРОМИШЛЕНОСТ" (Mining industry), while the bar for "Преработваща промишленост" is blue.
